papers.title: RoboAlign-R1: Distilled Multimodal Reward Alignment for Robot Video World Models
papers.summary: 现在的机器人视频世界模型大多用重建/感知相似度训，跟决策真正关心的指令跟随、操作成功、物理合理性脱节，长程展开还会漂。RoboAlign-R1 用一个大模型 judge 给六维评分蒸馏出轻量奖励模型做 RL 后训练，再加滑窗重编码稳定长程预测，六维总分提了 10.1%。
papers.original_abstract: Existing robot video world models are typically trained with low-level objectives such as reconstruction and perceptual similarity, which are poorly aligned with the capabilities that matter most for robot decision making, including instruction following, manipulation success, and physical plausibility. They also suffer from error accumulation in long-horizon autoregressive prediction. We present RoboAlign-R1, a framework that combines reward-aligned post-training with stabilized long-horizon inference for robot video world models. We construct RobotWorldBench, a benchmark of 10,000 annotated video-instruction pairs collected from four robot data sources, and train a multimodal teacher judge, RoboAlign-Judge, to provide fine-grained six-dimensional evaluation of generated videos. We then distill the teacher into a lightweight student reward model for efficient reinforcement-learning-based post-training. To reduce long-horizon rollout drift, we further introduce Sliding Window Re-encoding (SWR), a training-free inference strategy that periodically refreshes the generation context. Under our in-domain evaluation protocol, RoboAlign-R1 improves the aggregate six-dimension score by 10.1% over the strongest baseline, including gains of 7.5% on Manipulation Accuracy and 4.6% on Instruction Following; these ranking improvements are further supported by an external VLM-based cross-check and a blinded human study. Meanwhile, SWR improves long-horizon prediction quality with only about 1% additional latency, yielding a 2.8% gain in SSIM and a 9.8% reduction in LPIPS. Together, these results show that reward-aligned post-training and stabilized long-horizon decoding improve task consistency, physical realism, and long-horizon prediction quality in robot video world models.

highlights.contribution: 构建 RobotWorldBench 与 RoboAlign-Judge，把奖励对齐式后训练和长程稳定推理结合，让视频世界模型对齐机器人决策需求。
highlights.innovation: 首次把多模态 judge 蒸馏成轻量学生奖励模型用于 RL 后训练；提出 Sliding Window Re-encoding 训练-free 推理稳定策略。
highlights.method: 标注 1 万条视频-指令对训练六维 judge，再蒸馏成学生 reward；用 RL 后训练视频世界模型；推理时周期性刷新上下文（SWR）抑制长程漂移。
highlights.results: 六维总分较最强基线 +10.1%（操作准确 +7.5%，指令跟随 +4.6%）；SWR 多 1% 延迟换 SSIM +2.8%、LPIPS -9.8%。

papers.title: iWorld-Bench: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
papers.summary: 交互式世界模型缺一个统一 benchmark。iWorld-Bench 收 33 万视频片段挑出 2.1k 高质量样本，再统一设计 Action Generation Framework 让不同模态的世界模型在六类任务（视觉生成 / 轨迹跟踪 / 记忆）上同台测，评了 14 个代表性世界模型并指出短板。
papers.original_abstract: Achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) requires agents that learn and interact adaptively, with interactive world models providing scalable environments for perception, reasoning, and action. Yet current research still lacks large-scale datasets and unified benchmarks to evaluate their physical interaction capabilities. To address this, we propose iWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for training and testing world models on interaction-related abilities such as distance perception and memory. We construct a diverse dataset with 330k video clips and select 2.1k high-quality samples covering varied perspectives, weather, and scenes. As existing world models differ in interaction modalities, we introduce an Action Generation Framework to unify evaluation and design six task types, generating 4.9k test samples. These tasks jointly assess model performance across visual generation, trajectory following, and memory. Evaluating 14 representative world models, we identify key limitations and provide insights for future research. The iWorld-Bench model leaderboard is publicly available at iWorld-Bench.com.

highlights.contribution: 推出 iWorld-Bench，一个面向交互式世界模型的统一训练与评测基准，覆盖距离感知、记忆等核心交互能力。
highlights.innovation: 用 Action Generation Framework 统一不同动作接口的世界模型评测；任务覆盖视觉生成 + 轨迹跟随 + 记忆三个维度。
highlights.method: 采集 330k 视频片段，筛选 2.1k 高质量样本覆盖视角/天气/场景；设计六类任务生成 4.9k 测试样本；评测 14 个代表性世界模型并发布在线 leaderboard。
highlights.results: 在 14 个代表世界模型上做了横向对比，指出现有模型在交互能力上的关键局限；leaderboard 在 iWorld-Bench.com 公开。

papers.title: Learning to Theorize the World from Observation
papers.summary: 作者觉得现在的世界模型大都把「理解」等同于在 latent 里预测未来，但发展心理学说人是先构建解释性理论才理解世界。NEO 把「理论」显式做成可执行的潜程序，从原始观测里推断出来，再用共享的转移模型执行，能用学到的原语组合解释新现象。
papers.original_abstract: What does it mean to understand the world? Contemporary world models often operationalize understanding as accurate future prediction in latent or observation space. Developmental cognitive science, however, suggests a different view: human understanding emerges through the construction of internal theories of how the world works, even before mature language is acquired. Inspired by this theory-building view of cognition, we introduce Learning-to-Theorize, a learning paradigm for inferring explicit explanatory theories of the world from raw, non-textual observations. We instantiate this paradigm with the Neural Theorizer (NEO), a probabilistic neural model that induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought and executes them through a shared transition model. In NEO, a theory is represented as an executable, compositional program whose learned primitives can be systematically recombined to explain novel phenomena. Experiments show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.

highlights.contribution: 提出 Learning-to-Theorize 范式和 Neural Theorizer (NEO)，从非文本观测中归纳出显式可执行的世界理论。
highlights.innovation: 把世界模型从「潜空间预测」换成「潜程序归纳」，引入可组合的 Language of Thought，让原语能在共享转移模型里重组。
highlights.method: 概率神经模型 NEO 从原始观测推断出可执行程序，把它当作 Language of Thought，再用一个共享转移模型执行程序得到预测。
highlights.results: 在多个观测预测/解释任务上展示出解释驱动的组合泛化能力，能用学到的原语解释新现象（无具体 benchmark 数字）。

papers.title: JoyAI-Image: Awaking Spatial Intelligence in Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
papers.summary: JoyAI-Image 把 MLLM 和多模态扩散 Transformer 接到一起，做一个统一的视觉理解 + T2I + 编辑模型，重点是空间智能。靠空间标注数据和编辑信号做训练，理解和编辑能形成正反馈，作者声称在多个基准上 SOTA 或接近 SOTA，并强调对 VLA 和世界模型有应用价值。
papers.original_abstract: We present JoyAI-Image, a unified multimodal foundation model for visual understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided image editing. JoyAI-Image couples a spatially enhanced Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT), allowing perception and generation to interact through a shared multimodal interface. Around this architecture, we build a scalable training recipe that combines unified instruction tuning, long-text rendering supervision, spatially grounded data, and both general and spatial editing signals. This design gives the model broad multimodal capability while strengthening geometry-aware reasoning and controllable visual synthesis. Experiments across understanding, generation, long-text rendering, and editing benchmarks show that JoyAI-Image achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance. More importantly, the bidirectional loop between enhanced understanding, controllable spatial editing, and novel-view-assisted reasoning enables the model to move beyond general visual competence toward stronger spatial intelligence. These results suggest a promising path for unified visual models in downstream applications such as vision-language-action systems and world models.

highlights.contribution: 提出 JoyAI-Image，一个统一的多模态基础模型，同时做视觉理解、文生图、指令编辑，并在空间智能上做了显式强化。
highlights.innovation: 把空间增强的 MLLM 和 MMDiT 用共享多模态接口耦合；引入空间编辑信号 + 长文渲染监督把理解-生成-编辑形成 bidirectional loop。
highlights.method: MLLM 提供空间感知和指令理解，MMDiT 负责图像合成与编辑；训练上做统一指令微调、长文渲染监督、空间标注数据和一般+空间编辑数据混训。
highlights.results: 在理解/生成/长文渲染/编辑多 benchmark 上达到 SOTA 或具有竞争力（具体数字未列）；强调空间智能可外溢到 VLA 和世界模型。

papers.title: What You Think is What You See: Driving Exploration in VLM Agents via Visual-Linguistic Curiosity
papers.summary: VLM agent 现在靠 CoT 内化世界模型在脑子里推未来，但只在已访问状态上推不够，稀疏奖励任务还得主动找「已知的未知」。GLANCE 把语言世界模型对齐到一个慢更新的目标视觉网络，用语言预测和视觉现实的差当好奇心信号驱动 RL，让 agent 主动去探不确定区域。
papers.original_abstract: To navigate partially observable visual environments, recent VLM agents increasingly internalize world modeling capabilities into their policies via explicit CoT reasoning, enabling them to mentally simulate futures before acting. However, relying solely on passive reasoning over visited states is insufficient for sparse-reward tasks, as it lacks the epistemic drive to actively uncover the ``known unknown'' required for robust generalization. We ask: Can VLM agents actively find signals that challenge and refine their internal world model through curiosity-driven exploration? In this work, we propose GLANCE, a unified framework that bridges reasoning and exploration by grounding the agent's linguistic world model into the stable visual representations of an evolving target network. Crucially, GLANCE leverages the discrepancy between linguistic prediction and visual reality as an intrinsic curiosity signal within reinforcement learning, steering the agent to actively explore areas where its internal model is uncertain. Extensive experiments across a series of agentic tasks show the effectiveness of GLANCE, and demonstrate that aligning ``what the agent thinks'' with ``what the agent sees'' is key to solving complex or sparse agentic tasks.

highlights.contribution: 提出 GLANCE，把 VLM 的语言世界模型和视觉表征通过差异驱动的好奇心 RL 显式对齐，让 agent 主动探索。
highlights.innovation: 用语言预测 vs 视觉现实的不一致作为内在好奇心奖励；引入慢更新目标视觉网络稳定 grounding。
highlights.method: VLM agent 在 RL 中以语言预测对未来状态做 CoT，目标网络提供稳定视觉表征，二者差异作为 intrinsic reward 驱动探索。
highlights.results: 在多个 agentic 任务（特别是稀疏奖励/部分观测）上效果优于现有探索方法，验证「想」和「看」对齐能提升复杂任务表现（具体数字未列）。

papers.title: Robust Visual SLAM for UAV Navigation in GPS-Denied and Degraded Environments: A Multi-Paradigm Evaluation and Deployment Study
papers.summary: 无人机在 GPS 失效、视觉退化环境下定位是刚需。这篇横评 ORB-SLAM3 / DPVO / DROID-SLAM / DUSt3R / MASt3R 五个 SLAM，覆盖经典到 ViT 范式，在四个公开 benchmark + 自采数据集 + 五种退化条件下打分。结论是学习类方法更鲁棒，MASt3R 误差最低，DPVO 嵌入式部署性价比最好。
papers.original_abstract: Reliable localization in GPS-denied, visually degraded environments is critical for autonomous UAV opera- tions. This paper presents a systematic comparative evaluation of five V-SLAM systems ORB-SLAM3, DPVO, DROID-SLAM, DUSt3R, and MASt3R spanning classical, deep learning, recurrent, and Vision Transformer (ViT) paradigms. Experiments are conducted on curated sequences from four public benchmarks (TUM RGB-D, EuRoC MAV, UMA-VI, SubT-MRS) and a custom monocular indoor dataset under five controlled degradation conditions (normal, low light, dust haze, motion blur, and combined), with sub-millimeter Vicon ground truth. Results show that ORB-SLAM3 fails critically under severe degradation (62.4% overall TSR; 0% under dense haze), while learning-based methods remain robust: MASt3R achieves the lowest degraded ATE (0.027 m) and DUSt3R the highest tracking success (96.5%). DPVO offers the best efficiency robustness trade-off (18.6 FPS, 3.1 GB GPU memory, 86.1% TSR), making it the preferred choice for memory-constrained embedded platforms. Embedded deployment analysis across NVIDIA Jetson platforms provides actionable guidelines for SLAM selection under SWaP-constrained UAV scenarios.

highlights.contribution: 在 GPS 失效 + 视觉退化场景下系统横评五类 V-SLAM，给出 UAV 上 SLAM 选型与 Jetson 部署的实操指南。
highlights.innovation: 把 DUSt3R / MASt3R 这类 ViT/3D 基础模型纳入统一退化-鲁棒性评测，并配 Vicon 真值。
highlights.method: 在 TUM RGB-D / EuRoC / UMA-VI / SubT-MRS + 自采数据集上设五种退化（正常/弱光/雾尘/运动模糊/混合），统一指标对比五系统并在 Jetson 平台测部署。
highlights.results: ORB-SLAM3 在严重退化下崩 (TSR 62.4%，雾天 0%)；MASt3R ATE 最低 0.027m；DUSt3R 跟踪成功率 96.5%；DPVO 18.6 FPS、3.1GB、TSR 86.1%。

papers.title: What Happens Inside Agent Memory? Circuit Analysis from Emergence to Diagnosis
papers.summary: agent 记忆失败很隐蔽，模型可能答得很流畅但其实根本没存下信息。作者用电路追踪在 Qwen-3 系列（0.6B-14B）+ mem0/A-MEM 框架上看 write-manage-read 各阶段实际跑在模型哪里。两个机制发现：路由电路在 0.6B 就能查到，但内容电路要 4B 才稳定；read/write 共享的不是新建 hub 而是底层模型本来就有的 context-grounding 子电路。基于此做了个无监督诊断，silent 失败定位准确率 76.2%。
papers.original_abstract: Agent memory failures are silent: an LLM-based agent can produce a fluent response even when it fails to extract, retain, or retrieve the information needed across sessions. The write-manage-read loop describes the external pipeline of these systems but leaves open which internal computations implement each stage. Tracing feature circuits across the Qwen-3 family (0.6B--14B) and two memory frameworks (mem0 and A-MEM), we report two mechanistic findings and one deliverable. First, control is detectable before content: routing circuitry is causally active at 0.6B, while content circuitry produces no detectable signal until 4B, exposing a deployment regime where small models route memory decisions before they can reliably extract or ground the underlying facts. Second, the shared hub is recruited, not created: Write and Read converge on a late-layer hub that already exists in the base model as a context-grounding substrate, and memory framing recruits a memory-specific functional direction on this substrate rather than building one of its own. Both findings transfer across mem0 and A-MEM, indicating that the underlying computations are properties of the base model rather than of any particular interface. Building on this circuit structure, we develop an unsupervised stage-level diagnostic that localizes silent failures to the responsible operation up to 76.2% accuracy, outperforming the strongest supervised baseline by 13 points. Together, these results point to circuit-level signatures as a practical handle for monitoring and structurally-guided design of agent memory.

highlights.contribution: 首次从电路层面解析 LLM agent 记忆系统的 write-manage-read 实际计算，并给出一个超越监督基线的 silent 失败诊断器。
highlights.innovation: 证明控制（routing）比内容更早涌现；agent memory 共享的 hub 是 base model 已有的 context-grounding substrate，而非框架新建；结论跨 mem0/A-MEM 转移。
highlights.method: 在 Qwen-3 0.6B/4B/14B 上对 mem0 与 A-MEM 两种 memory framework 做 feature circuit 追踪；分阶段对照 write/manage/read；基于电路结构搭建无监督 stage-level 诊断器。
highlights.results: 诊断器在 silent 失败定位上达到 76.2% 准确率，比最强监督基线高 13 个百分点；机制发现可在两种框架间迁移。

papers.title: Learning Reactive Dexterous Grasping via Hierarchical Task-Space RL Planning and Joint-Space QP Control
papers.summary: 灵巧手做 reactive 抓取要同时管高层规划和低层关节控制，端到端 RL 训练慢、还很难保安全。作者把它分两层：上面用多 agent RL（arm agent + hand agent）出 task-space 速度指令，下面用 GPU 并行 QP 控制器把指令转成关节速度，硬卡运动学约束和避障。这种结构训练快、硬件安全有保证，还能 zero-shot 改安全 margin 不用重训。7 DoF 臂 + 20 DoF 手实物上抓没见过的物体效果稳。
papers.original_abstract: In this work, we propose a hybrid hierarchical control framework for reactive dexterous grasping that explicitly decouples high-level spatial intent from low-level joint execution. We introduce a multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture, specialized into distinct arm and hand agents, that acts as a high-level planner by generating desired task-space velocity commands. These commands are then processed by a GPU-parallelized quadratic programming controller, which translates them into feasible joint velocities while strictly enforcing kinematic limits and collision avoidance. This structural isolation not only accelerates training convergence but also strictly enforces hardware safety. Furthermore, the architecture unlocks zero-shot steerability, allowing system operators to dynamically adjust safety margins and avoid dynamic obstacles without retraining the policy. We extensively validate the proposed framework through a rigorous simulation-to-reality pipeline. Real-world hardware experiments on a 7-DoF arm equipped with a 20-DoF anthropomorphic hand demonstrate highly robust zero-shot transferability for dexterous grasping to a diverse set of unseen objects, highlighting the system's ability to reactively recover from unexpected physical disturbances in unstructured environments.

highlights.contribution: 提出 hybrid 分层框架，把 reactive 灵巧抓取的高层空间意图和低层关节执行结构性解耦。
highlights.innovation: 高层多 agent RL（arm + hand 分工）只学 task-space 指令，关节层用 GPU 并行 QP 控制器强制约束，自然支持 zero-shot 调安全 margin 和动态避障，无需重训策略。
highlights.method: 上层 multi-agent RL 输出 task-space velocity command；下层 GPU 并行 QP 控制器转关节速度并强制 kinematic limits + collision avoidance；sim-to-real pipeline；7 DoF 臂 + 20 DoF 拟人手实物部署。
highlights.results: 实物对多种未见物体显示强 zero-shot 抓取迁移；对突发物理扰动有 reactive 恢复能力；未给统一量化对比。

papers.title: CASCADE: Case-Based Continual Adaptation for Large Language Models During Deployment
papers.summary: LLM 部署后基本就停止学习了，跟生物智能正好相反。作者把『部署期学习』（DTL）形式化成 LLM 生命周期的第三阶段，提了 CASCADE：给 agent 一个可演化的 episodic memory，把经验复用建成 contextual bandit，提供 no-regret 理论保证。16 个跨领域任务（医疗、法律、代码、web search、tool use、embodied 交互）上比 zero-shot 平均成功率提升 20.9%，超过 gradient 和 memory 基线。
papers.original_abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a central foundation of modern artificial intelligence, yet their lifecycle remains constrained by a rigid separation between training and deployment, after which learning effectively ceases. This limitation contrasts with natural intelligence, which continually adapts through interaction with its environment. In this paper, we formalise deployment-time learning (DTL) as the third stage in the LLM lifecycle that enables LLM agents to improve from experience during deployment without modifying model parameters. We present CASCADE (CASe-based Continual Adaptation during DEployment), a general and principled framework that equips LLM agents with an explicit, evolving episodic memory. CASCADE formulates experience reuse as a contextual bandit problem, enabling principled exploration-exploitation trade-offs and establishing no-regret guarantees over long-term interactions. This design allows agents to accumulate, select, and refine task-relevant cases, transforming past experience into actionable knowledge. Across 16 diverse tasks spanning medical diagnosis, legal analysis, code generation, web search, tool use, and embodied interaction, CASCADE improves macro-averaged success rate by 20.9% over zero-shot prompting while consistently outperforming gradient-based and memory-based baselines. By reframing deployment as an adaptive learning process, this work establishes a foundation for continually improving AI systems.

highlights.contribution: 形式化『部署期学习』概念，并提出一个有理论保证（no-regret）的可演化记忆框架 CASCADE。
highlights.innovation: 把经验复用建模成 contextual bandit，给出原则化的 exploration-exploitation 权衡和 no-regret 长期保证，区别于纯启发式 memory 系统。
highlights.method: 构建显式可演化 episodic memory；contextual bandit 选择历史经验；无需修改模型参数；在 16 个任务（含 embodied 交互）上评测。
highlights.results: macro-averaged 成功率比 zero-shot prompt 提升 20.9%，并稳定超过 gradient-based 和 memory-based 基线。

papers.title: Agentic-imodels: Evolving agentic interpretability tools via autoresearch
papers.summary: Agentic data science 系统越来越强，但现在用的统计工具是给人看的不是给 agent 看的。作者搞了个 autoresearch loop 来演化 scikit-learn 兼容的 tabular 回归器，目标同时是预测好和『LLM 可解释』。可解释性指标是一套 LLM-as-judge 的 simulatability 测试。结果演化出的模型既好预测又对 agent 友好，能泛化到新数据集和新测试，下游接 Copilot CLI、Claude Code、Codex 在 BLADE benchmark 上最高涨 73%。
papers.original_abstract: Agentic data science (ADS) systems are rapidly improving their capability to autonomously analyze, fit, and interpret data, potentially moving towards a future where agents conduct the vast majority of data-science work. However, current ADS systems use statistical tools designed to be interpretable by humans, rather than interpretable by agents. To address this, we introduce Agentic-imodels, an agentic autoresearch loop that evolves data-science tools designed to be interpretable by agents. Specifically, it develops a library of scikit-learn-compatible regressors for tabular data that are optimized for both predictive performance and a novel LLM-based interpretability metric. The metric measures a suite of LLM-graded tests that probe whether a fitted model's string representation is "simulatable" by an LLM, i.e. whether the LLM can answer questions about the model's behavior by reading its string output alone. We find that the evolved models jointly improve predictive performance and agent-facing interpretability, generalizing to new datasets and new interpretability tests. Furthermore, these evolved models improve downstream end-to-end ADS, increasing performance for Copilot CLI, Claude Code, and Codex on the BLADE benchmark by up to 73%

highlights.contribution: 提出 agent-facing interpretability 概念，并用 agentic autoresearch loop 演化出兼顾预测与 agent 可解释性的模型库。
highlights.innovation: 把 interpretability 重新定义为 LLM simulatability，而不是人类可读性，并通过 LLM judge 自动评测；用 autoresearch 演化整套 sklearn 兼容回归器。
highlights.method: Agentic autoresearch loop 在 sklearn 接口下进化模型；联合优化预测性能与 LLM 可解释性 metric（一套 LLM-graded simulatability 测试）；下游接 Copilot CLI / Claude Code / Codex 评测。
highlights.results: 演化模型同时改进预测和 agent 解释性，可泛化到新数据和新解释性测试；BLADE benchmark 上下游 ADS 性能最高提升 73%。

papers.title: ScrapMem: A Bio-inspired Framework for On-device Personalized Agent Memory via Optical Forgetting
papers.summary: 端侧 LLM agent 长期个性化记忆受存储和多模态拖累，作者借生物记忆衰退的思路提了 ScrapMem：把多模态记忆塞进『剪贴本页面』，再做 Optical Forgetting——旧记忆逐步降分辨率，省存储还顺手抹细节。语义连贯靠 Episodic Memory Graph 把关键事件串成因果-时序结构。多模态 ATM-Bench 上 Joint@10 51.0% SOTA，存储省 93%，Recall@10 涨到 70.3%。
papers.original_abstract: Long-term personalized memory for LLM agents is challenging on resource-limited edge devices due to high storage costs and multimodal complexity. To address this, we propose ScrapMem, a framework that integrates multimodal data into "Scrapbook Page." ScrapMem introduces Optical Forgetting, an optical compression mechanism that progressively reduces the resolution of older memories, lowering storage cost while suppressing low-value details. To maintain semantic consistency, we construct an Episodic Memory Graph (EM-Graph) that organizes key events into a causal-temporal structure. Extensive experiments on the multimodal ATM-Bench showcase that ScrapMem provides three main benefits: (1) strong performance, achieving a new state-of-the-art with a 51.0% Joint@10 score; (2) high storage efficiency, reducing memory usage by up to 93% via optical forgetting; and (3) improved recall, increasing Recall@10 to 70.3% through structured aggregation. ScrapMem offers an effective and storage-efficient solution for on-device long-term memory in multimodal LLM agents.

highlights.contribution: 面向端侧多模态 LLM agent 提出仿生 long-term memory 框架，兼顾存储效率和召回率。
highlights.innovation: Optical Forgetting 用光学风格的分辨率衰减压缩旧记忆，同时配 Episodic Memory Graph 保持语义因果时序，结合了生物启发和图结构。
highlights.method: Scrapbook Page 把多模态记忆统一存储；Optical Forgetting 渐进降分辨率；EM-Graph 把关键事件组织成因果-时序图；端侧多模态 LLM agent 接入。
highlights.results: ATM-Bench Joint@10 51.0% 新 SOTA；存储最高省 93%；Recall@10 由结构化聚合提升到 70.3%。

papers.title: From Intent to Execution: Composing Agentic Workflows with Agent Recommendation
papers.summary: 搭多 agent 系统现在还是个手工活：规划、选 agent、画执行图都得人写。作者搞了个全流程自动化框架，核心是个 LLM 规划器 + 动态调用图 + agent 推荐器，推荐器走两段式 IR（快检索 + LLM 重排），还配了个 critique agent 整体把关 agent 和 tool 选择。实验里召回率打过 SOTA，加 critique 后又涨一波。
papers.original_abstract: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) built using AI agents fulfill a variety of user intents that may be used to design and build a family of related applications. However, the creation of such MAS currently involves manual composition of the plan, manual selection of appropriate agents, and manual creation of execution graphs. This paper introduces a framework for the automated creation of multi-agent systems which replaces multiple manual steps with an automated framework. The proposed framework consists of software modules and a workflow to orchestrate the requisite task- specific application. The modules include: an LLM-derived planner, a set of tasks described in natural language, a dynamic call graph, an orchestrator for map agents to tasks, and an agent recommender that finds the most suitable agent(s) from local and global agent registries. The agent recommender uses a two-stage information retrieval (IR) system comprising a fast retriever and an LLM-based re-ranker. We implemented a series of experiments exploring the choice of embedders, re- rankers, agent description enrichment, and supervising critique agent. We benchmarked this system end-to-end, evaluating the combination of planning, agent selection, and task completion, with our proposed approach. Our experimental results show that our approach outperforms the state-of-the- art in terms of the recall rate and is more robust and scalable compared to previous approaches. The critique agent holistically reevaluates both agent and tool recommendations against the overall plan. We show that the inclusion of the critique agent further enhances the recall score, proving that the comprehensive review and revision of task-based agent selection is an essential step in building end-to-end multi-agent systems.

highlights.contribution: 把多 agent 系统的规划、agent 选择、执行图编排做成端到端自动化，可扩展到 local + global agent 注册表。
highlights.innovation: 把 agent 推荐当成两段式 IR 问题，配 critique agent 全局复审，比单 pass LLM 选择更鲁棒。
highlights.method: LLM 派生 planner + 自然语言任务描述 + 动态调用图 + orchestrator 负责 map agent 到 task；agent recommender 用快检索器 + LLM 重排；critique agent 整体审查选择结果；做了 embedder/reranker/agent 描述增强等消融。
highlights.results: 端到端规划 + agent 选择 + 任务完成评测中召回率超过现有 SOTA，加 critique 后召回进一步提升，但论文未给具体数字。

papers.title: Evaluating Generative Models as Interactive Emergent Representations of Human-Like Collaborative Behavior
papers.summary: foundation model agent 跟人类配合时会不会自发表现出协作行为，是个开放问题。作者搭了个 2D 颜色匹配协作游戏，让 LLM agent 跟人一起玩，再用 LLM-as-judge 自动检测五种协作行为（视角换位、考虑同伴的规划、内省、心智理论、澄清）。结果发现这些行为在没专门训练下也会自发涌现，不同 LLM 模式还不一样；用户研究也说挺满意，但希望响应更快、更像人。
papers.original_abstract: Human-AI collaboration requires AI agents to understand human behavior for effective coordination. While advances in foundation models show promising capabilities in understanding and showing human-like behavior, their application in embodied collaborative settings needs further investigation. This work examines whether embodied foundation model agents exhibit emergent collaborative behaviors indicating underlying mental models of their collaborators, which is an important aspect of effective coordination. This paper develops a 2D collaborative game environment where large language model agents and humans complete color-matching tasks requiring coordination. We define five collaborative behaviors as indicators of emergent mental model representation: perspective-taking, collaborator-aware planning, introspection, theory of mind, and clarification. An automated behavior detection system using LLM-based judges identifies these behaviors, achieving fair to substantial agreement with human annotations. Results from the automated behavior detection system show that foundation models consistently exhibit emergent collaborative behaviors without being explicitly trained to do so. These behaviors occur at varying frequencies during collaboration stages, with distinct patterns across different LLMs. A user study was also conducted to evaluate human satisfaction and perceived collaboration effectiveness, with the results indicating positive collaboration experiences. Participants appreciated the agents' task focus, plan verbalization, and initiative, while suggesting improvements in response times and human-like interactions. This work provides an experimental framework for human-AI collaboration, empirical evidence of collaborative behaviors in embodied LLM agents, a validated behavioral analysis methodology, and an assessment of collaboration effectiveness.

highlights.contribution: 给具身人机协作 LLM agent 提出一套自动化协作行为检测方法和实证证据，含用户研究。
highlights.innovation: 定义五种协作行为作为心智模型 emergent indicator，搭 LLM-as-judge 自动检测系统，跟人标注做了 fair-to-substantial 一致性验证。
highlights.method: 2D 颜色匹配协作环境，LLM agent 与人协同；定义视角换位、协同感知规划、内省、ToM、澄清五种行为；LLM-based judge 自动检测；多个 LLM 横评；配套人类用户满意度研究。
highlights.results: 多个 foundation model 在无显式训练下持续表现五种协作行为，频率随协作阶段不同；用户报告积极协作体验，但希望提速。

papers.title: Robust Agent Compensation (RAC): Teaching AI Agents to Compensate
papers.summary: 现在的 agent 框架一旦执行中崩了，要么重跑要么靠 LLM 自己回滚，副作用和成本都很难控。作者借鉴数据库 saga 思路提了 RAC：基于日志的恢复架构层，可以挂到 LangGraph 这种现有 agent 框架上，不改用户代码。在 τ-bench 和 REALM-Bench 上比 SOTA 的 LLM-based recovery 在延迟和 token 成本上快 1.5-8 倍以上。
papers.original_abstract: We present Robust Agent Compensation (RAC), a log-based recovery paradigm (providing a safety net) implemented through an architectural extension that can be applied to most Agent frameworks to support reliable executions (avoiding unintended side effects). Users can choose to enable RAC without changing their current agent code (e.g., LangGraph agents). The proposed approach can be implemented in most existing agent frameworks via their existing extension points. We present an implementation based on LangChain, demonstrate its viability through the $τ$-bench and REALM-Bench, and show that when solving complex problems, RAC is 1.5-8X or more better in both latency and token economy compared to state-of-the-art LLM-based recovery approaches.

highlights.contribution: 为 agent 框架补一层日志驱动的可靠恢复机制 RAC，可以挂到现有 LangChain/LangGraph 等框架而不改业务代码。
highlights.innovation: 用 log-based compensation 思路替代 LLM-based 自恢复，靠架构层提供安全网，省 token 又快。
highlights.method: 在 LangChain 上实现 RAC 扩展点；以日志为基础提供 compensation/recovery；通过现有 agent 框架扩展点接入。
highlights.results: 在 τ-bench 和 REALM-Bench 上比 SOTA LLM-based recovery 在 latency 和 token 经济性上提升 1.5-8 倍以上。

papers.title: MEMSAD: Gradient-Coupled Anomaly Detection for Memory Poisoning in Retrieval-Augmented Agents
papers.summary: RAG agent 的外部记忆能被人投毒，但攻防一直没好评测协议。作者把 memory poisoning 形式化成 Stackelberg 博弈，纠正了 Chen et al. 2024 的 triggered-query 评测漏洞（修正后攻击成功率 4 倍跃升）。再提 MEMSAD 防御：基于梯度耦合定理证明 anomaly score 和检索目标梯度等价，所以攻击者降检测就得损检索。给了 minimax 最优样本复杂度和 online regret 界，复合防御做到 TPR 1.00/FPR 0.00。
papers.original_abstract: Persistent external memory enables LLM agents to maintain context across sessions, yet its security properties remain formally uncharacterized. We formalize memory poisoning attacks on retrieval-augmented agents as a Stackelberg game with a unified evaluation framework spanning three attack classes with escalating access assumptions. Correcting an evaluation protocol inconsistency in the triggered-query specification of Chen et al. (2024), we show faithful evaluation increases measured attack success by $4\times$ (ASR-R: $0.25 \to 1.00$). Our primary contribution is MEMSAD (Semantic Anomaly Detection), a calibration-based defense grounded in a gradient coupling theorem: under encoder regularity, the anomaly score gradient and the retrieval objective gradient are provably identical, so any continuous perturbation that reduces detection risk necessarily degrades retrieval rank. This coupling yields a certified detection radius guaranteeing correct classification regardless of adversary strategy. We prove minimax optimality via Le Cam's method, showing any threshold detector requires $Ω(1/ρ^2)$ calibration samples and MEMSAD achieves this up to $\log(1/δ)$ factors. We further derive online regret bounds for rolling calibration at rate $O(σ^{2/3}Δ^{1/3})$, and formally characterize a discrete synonym-invariance loophole that marks the boundary of what continuous-space defenses can guarantee. Experiments on a $3 \times 5$ attack-defense matrix with bootstrap confidence intervals, Bonferroni-corrected hypothesis tests, and Clopper-Pearson validation ($n=1{,}000$) confirm: composite defenses achieve TPR $= 1.00$, FPR $= 0.00$ across all attacks, while synonym substitution evades detection at $Δ$ ASR-R $\approx 0$, exposing a gap existing embedding-based defenses cannot close.

highlights.contribution: 给 LLM agent 外部记忆投毒首次提供形式化博弈框架 + 带认证检测半径的防御 MEMSAD。
highlights.innovation: 证明 anomaly score 梯度与 retrieval objective 梯度恒等，给出认证检测半径；用 Le Cam 法证 minimax 样本复杂度最优；指出离散同义替换是连续空间防御的根本盲区。
highlights.method: 三类攻击 × 五种防御组成评测矩阵；MEMSAD 用 calibration-based 阈值检测，配 rolling calibration 在线版；理论分析 + bootstrap CI、Bonferroni、Clopper-Pearson 验证。
highlights.results: 纠正评测后 ASR-R 从 0.25 飙到 1.00；MEMSAD 复合防御达 TPR 1.00、FPR 0.00；但 synonym substitution 仍能绕过，暴露 embedding 防御的根本极限。

papers.title: Say the Mission, Execute the Swarm: Agent-Enhanced LLM Reasoning in the Web-of-Drones
papers.summary: 用 LLM 给无人机集群当大脑听起来很美，但实际跑长周期闭环执行经常因为接口异构和缺 grounding 翻车。作者搭了个 LLM Agent Core + MCP gateway + Web-of-Drones（基于 W3C WoT 标准）的架构：无人机/传感器/服务统一暴露成 WoT Things，agent 通过结构化工具调用控制，不需要生成代码。在 ArduPilot 仿真四个 swarm 任务 + 六个 SOTA LLM 上发现：通用 LLM 即使简单任务也跑得不稳，但加 planning 工具和 runtime guardrail 后鲁棒性显著提升；token 消耗跟执行质量没关系。
papers.original_abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly explored as high-level reasoning engines for cyber-physical systems, yet their application to real-time UAV swarm management remains challenging due to heterogeneous interfaces, limited grounding, and the need for long-running closed-loop execution. This paper presents a mission-agnostic, agent-enhanced LLM framework for UAV swarm control, where users express mission objectives in natural language and the system autonomously executes them through grounded, real-time interactions. The proposed architecture combines an LLM-based Agent Core with a Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway and a Web-of-Drones abstraction based on W3C Web of Things (WoT) standards. By exposing drones, sensors, and services as standardized WoT Things, the framework enables structured tool-based interaction, continuous state observation, and safe actuation without relying on code generation. We evaluate the framework using ArduPilot-based simulation across four swarm missions and six state-of-the-art LLMs. Results show that, despite strong reasoning abilities, current general-purpose LLMs still struggle to achieve reliable execution - even for simple swarm tasks - when operating without explicit grounding and execution support. Task-specific planning tools and runtime guardrails substantially improve robustness, while token consumption alone is not indicative of execution quality or reliability.

highlights.contribution: 提出 mission-agnostic 的 LLM agent 框架，用 W3C WoT 标准统一抽象无人机集群，实现自然语言到 swarm 执行的闭环。
highlights.innovation: 用 WoT Things 把无人机/传感器/服务暴露成标准化接口，绕开 code generation，靠结构化 tool 调用做安全实时控制。
highlights.method: LLM Agent Core + MCP gateway + WoT-based Web-of-Drones 抽象；4 个 swarm mission；ArduPilot 仿真；横评 6 个 SOTA LLM；评测 planning tool 和 runtime guardrail 对鲁棒性的作用。
highlights.results: 纯 LLM 即使简单 swarm 任务也不稳；加 task-specific planning 工具和 runtime guardrail 后鲁棒性大幅提升；token 消耗与执行质量无关。

papers.title: GeoDecider: A Coarse-to-Fine Agentic Workflow for Explainable Lithology Classification
papers.summary: 岩性分类一直被当成一锤子分类任务做，但真正地质专家是会看上下文 + 调工具 + 套地质常识的。作者提了个 GeoDecider，免训练用 LLM 跑由粗到细的 agentic workflow：先用预训练分类器粗分缩范围，再用上下文分析和邻居检索这些工具细化，最后用地质规则后处理保一致。四个 benchmark 上打过基线，还可解释。
papers.original_abstract: Lithology classification aims to infer subsurface rock types from well-logging signals, supporting downstream applications like reservoir characterization. Despite substantial progress, most existing methods still treat lithology classification as a single-pass classification task. In contrast, practical experts incorporate geological principles, external knowledge, and tool-use capabilities to perform accurate classification. In this work, we propose GeoDecider, a coarse-to-fine agentic workflow that enables accurate and explainable lithology classification through training-free use of large language models (LLMs). GeoDecider reformulates lithology classification as an expert-like structured process and organizes it into a multi-stage workflow involving coarse-to-fine reasoning. Specifically, GeoDecider includes the following stages: (1) base classifier-guided coarse classification, which uses a pre-trained classifier to provide a rough reference for downstream tasks, thus reducing the overall cost of downstream reasoning, (2) tool-augmented reasoning, which utilizes several tools such as contextual analysis and neighbor retrieval to achieve finer and more precise classifications, (3) geological refinement, which post-processes the final results to enforce geological consistency. Experiments on four benchmarks show that GeoDecider outperforms representative baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that the proposed framework produces geologically interpretable predictions while achieving a better trade-off between classification performance and inference efficiency.

highlights.contribution: 把岩性分类重构成多阶段 agentic 推理流程，给出可解释且性能更好的免训练 LLM 方案。
highlights.innovation: 用 base classifier 引导 coarse 分类降低下游推理成本，再加 tool-augmented 推理和地质规则后处理三段式 workflow。
highlights.method: 三阶段 workflow：(1) 预训练分类器给粗参考，(2) 上下文分析 + 邻居检索等工具做精细分类，(3) 地质规则做后处理一致性校验；全程不训练 LLM。
highlights.results: 在 4 个 well-logging benchmark 上超过代表性基线；分析显示在性能和推理效率之间取得更好折中；论文未列绝对数字。

papers.title: CuraView: A Multi-Agent Framework for Medical Hallucination Detection with GraphRAG-Enhanced Knowledge Verification
papers.summary: LLM 写出院小结很快，但容易跟病历对不上，临床上这种 hallucination 直接威胁病人安全。CuraView 是个多 agent 框架，先把病人级 EHR 建成 GraphRAG 知识图，再做句子级证据检索 + 四级分级（强支持到直接矛盾），形成闭环生成-检测流水线。fine-tune 的 Qwen3-14B 在 Discharge-Me 子集 E4 上 F1 0.831，比 base 提了 50%。
papers.original_abstract: Discharge summaries require extracting critical information from lengthy electronic health records (EHRs), a process that is labor-intensive when performed manually. Large language models (LLMs) can improve generation efficiency; however, they are prone to producing faithfulness hallucinations, statements that contradict source records, posing direct risks to patient safety. To address this, we present CuraView, a multi-agent framework for sentence-level detection and evidence-grounded explanation of faithfulness hallucinations in discharge summaries. CuraView constructs a GraphRAG-based knowledge graph from patient-level EHRs and implements a closed-loop generation-detection pipeline with sentence-level evidence retrieval and classification spanning four evidence grades from strong support to direct contradiction (E1-E4), yielding structured and interpretable evidence chains.   We evaluate CuraView on a subset of 250 patients from the Discharge-Me benchmark, with 50 patients held out for testing. Our fine-tuned Qwen3-14B detection model achieves an F1 of 0.831 on the safety-critical E4 metric (90.9% recall, 76.5% precision) and an F1 of 0.823 on E3+E4, representing a 50.0% relative improvement over the base model and outperforming RAGTruth-style and QAGS-style baselines. These results demonstrate that evidence-chain-based graph retrieval verification substantially improves the factual reliability of clinical documentation, while simultaneously producing reusable annotated datasets for downstream model training and distillation.

highlights.contribution: 提出句子级、证据链可解释的多 agent 医疗 hallucination 检测框架，专门盯出院小结。
highlights.innovation: 用 GraphRAG 病人级知识图 + 四级证据等级（E1-E4）做证据链检索，对比 RAGTruth/QAGS 风格的纯检索基线更细更可控。
highlights.method: 从病人 EHR 构 GraphRAG 知识图；生成-检测闭环 pipeline；句子级证据检索 + 四级证据分类；用 250 病人子集训练，50 留测；fine-tune Qwen3-14B 检测器。
highlights.results: E4 上 F1 0.831（recall 90.9%/precision 76.5%），E3+E4 F1 0.823，相对 base model 提升 50%，打过 RAGTruth 和 QAGS 风格基线。

papers.title: Redefining AI Red Teaming in the Agentic Era: From Weeks to Hours
papers.summary: AI red teaming 现在搭一套 workflow 要拼几周 attack + transform + scorer，效率太低。作者基于 Dreadnode SDK 做了个 red teaming agent：自然语言描述目标，agent 自动选 attack、组 transform、跑执行、出报告，把工时从几周压到几小时。Llama Scout 案例 0 人工代码做到 85% 攻击成功率。
papers.original_abstract: AI systems are entering critical domains like healthcare, finance, and defense, yet remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. While AI red teaming is a primary defense, current approaches force operators into manual, library-specific workflows. Operators spend weeks hand-crafting workflows - assembling attacks, transforms, and scorers. When results fall short, workflows must be rebuilt. As a result, operators spend more time constructing workflows than probing targets for security and safety vulnerabilities.   We introduce an AI red teaming agent built on the open-source Dreadnode SDK. The agent creates workflows grounded in 45+ adversarial attacks, 450+ transforms, and 130+ scorers. Operators can probe multi-agent systems, multilingual, and multimodal targets, focusing on what to probe rather than how to implement it.   We make three contributions: 1. Agentic interface. Operators describe goals in natural language via the Dreadnode TUI (Terminal User Interface). The agent handles attack selection, transform composition, execution, and reporting, letting operators focus on red teaming. Weeks compress to hours. 2. Unified framework. A single framework for probing traditional ML models (adversarial examples) and generative AI systems (jailbreaks), removing the need for separate libraries. 3. Llama Scout case study. We red team Meta Llama Scout and achieve an 85% attack success rate with severity up to 1.0, using zero human-developed code

highlights.contribution: 把 AI red teaming 从手工拼装 workflow 升级成自然语言驱动的 agent 系统，覆盖传统 ML 和生成式 AI。
highlights.innovation: 统一框架同时处理对抗样本和 jailbreak，配 45+ 攻击 / 450+ transform / 130+ scorer 的工具库，省掉多库切换。
highlights.method: 基于 Dreadnode SDK 的 agent + Terminal UI；agent 自主选攻击、组合 transform、执行、生成报告；可探针多 agent、多语言、多模态目标。
highlights.results: Llama Scout 案例下零人工代码就跑出 85% 攻击成功率、severity 最高 1.0；将传统几周 workflow 压缩到几小时。

papers.title: Material Database Agent: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for Scientific Literature Mining
papers.summary: 材料科学文献里大量实验数据埋在表格、图和正文里，手动建库很痛苦。MDA 是个多模态多 agent 系统，PDF 进来后并行抽 markdown 和图，多个子 agent 并行读、拼成单论文 sub-database，最后一个 agent 整合成统一表格库。比起规则法和单 pass pipeline，更适合材料库这种结构化抽取。
papers.original_abstract: Materials science workflows rely on structured and unstructured data from the vast body of available scientific literature. However, most of the experimental details remain buried in text, tables, graphs and figures. Thus, constructing databases that incorporate this data is a manual, time-consuming, and hard-to-scale process. Multimodal large language models have made it feasible to extract information from text and scientific figures with high speed and accuracy. This opens the possibility of an AI system that can create production-scale material databases. Material Database Agent (MDA) is a modular, multi-agent system architecture for converting research literature into structured databases. MDA accepts article PDFs as input, which are subsequently processed in parallel into markdown files and figures. Multiple sub-agents read these markdown files and figures in parallel to assemble sub-databases for each paper. These sub-databases are then compiled into a single tabular database by an agent. As opposed to using either a rule-based approach or a single-pass pipeline for extracting information, MDA is a specialized architecture for transforming the literature into a database in the field of materials science. More generally, this study provides a basis for positioning multimodal agentic information extraction as a viable means for constructing next-generation scientific databases from the primary literature.

highlights.contribution: 提出端到端多模态多 agent 框架 MDA，把材料科学文献自动转结构化数据库。
highlights.innovation: 并行多子 agent 处理 markdown + figure，组合成单论文 sub-database 再整体合并，比 rule-based 或 single-pass 更适合表格 + 图的混合抽取。
highlights.method: PDF -> markdown + figure 并行处理；多个 sub-agent 并行读取并拼接单论文 sub-database；汇总 agent 整合成单表格库；基于多模态 LLM。
highlights.results: 在材料科学文献上验证可行性，但论文里没给量化对比指标。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Strategic Games with LLMs
papers.summary: 作者把 LLM 当成国际关系实验里的『实验对象』，让它们玩重复版安全困境，再加多极、有限期限、能通信三个维度。结果跨多个 LLM 都很一致：多极推高冲突，有限期限会出现 backward induction 式的全面崩盘，通信能促合作。还能直接看 agent 的私下推理和公开消息，把行为和策略 logic 挂钩。本质是给国关理论一种新的可扩展实验工具。
papers.original_abstract: This paper asks whether large language models (LLMs) can be used to study the strategic foundations of conflict and cooperation. I introduce LLMs as experimental subjects in a repeated security dilemma and evaluate whether they reproduce canonical mechanisms from international relations theory. The baseline game is extended along three theoretically central dimensions: multipolarity, finite time horizons, and the availability of communication. Across multiple models, the results exhibit systematic and consistent patterns: multipolarity increases the likelihood of conflict, finite horizons induce universal unraveling consistent with backward-induction logic, and communication reduces conflict by enabling signaling and reciprocity. Beyond observed behavior, the design provides access to agents' private reasoning and public messages, allowing choices to be linked to underlying strategic logics such as preemption, cooperation under uncertainty, and trust-building. The contribution is primarily methodological. LLM-based experiments offer a scalable, transparent, and replicable approach to probing theoretical mechanisms.

highlights.contribution: 把 LLM 当成国关理论实验的 agent，验证多极、有限期、通信三个维度上的经典机制。
highlights.innovation: 实验设计可同时读取 agent 私下推理和公开消息，把战略行为和潜在 logic（preemption、reciprocity、trust building）关联。
highlights.method: 重复 security dilemma 博弈，三个维度（多极/有限期/通信）扩展；多个 LLM 横评；分析私下 reasoning 和公开 message。
highlights.results: 多极增加冲突、有限期诱发全员 unraveling、通信通过信号和互惠降低冲突；不同 LLM 模式一致；属于方法论贡献，无单一数字。

papers.title: A Skill-Based AI Agentic Pipeline for Library of Congress Subject Indexing
papers.summary: 图书馆给书打 LC 主题词是个非常耗时的传统编目活。作者把它拆成四个顺序 agent skill：概念分析、定量过滤、权威验证、MARC 字段合成，每个 skill 都把 LC SHM 手册的规则编进去。10 本书上跟 Harvard 图书馆现有标题对比，整体方向对得上，但在 specificity、subdivision、2026 年新政策的执行细节上有差异。
papers.original_abstract: This paper presents a modular AI agentic skill pipeline for automating subject indexing with Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH). Subject indexing - the process of analyzing a work's aboutness, selecting controlled vocabulary terms, and encoding them as MARC21 subject access fields - is one of the most time-consuming components of library cataloging. The system decomposes this process into four discrete, sequentially executed agent skills: conceptual analysis, quantitative filtering, authority validation, and MARC field synthesis. Each skill encodes domain knowledge drawn directly from Library of Congress Subject Headings Manual (SHM) instruction sheets and subject analysis theory. The pipeline was evaluated against a corpus of ten titles whose existing subject headings were captured from the Harvard Library bibliographic dataset (a snapshot of their Alma ILS). Results demonstrate strong conceptual alignment with professional subject indexing practice, with notable differences in specificity, subdivision practice, and the agent's adherence to the 2026 LC policy discontinuing form subdivisions in favor of LCGFT 655 fields.

highlights.contribution: 给图书馆 LCSH 主题编目搭了一套 skill-based agentic pipeline，把传统手工流程拆成可审计的四个子 skill。
highlights.innovation: 把 LC SHM 手册和编目理论直接编码进 skill 的领域知识层，而不是靠通用 LLM prompt。
highlights.method: 四个顺序 agent skill：概念分析、定量过滤、权威 vocabulary 验证、MARC21 字段合成；每个 skill 内置 SHM 规则；用 Harvard 现有 catalog 做对照评测。
highlights.results: 在 10 本书的小规模评测中与专业编目实践有较强概念对齐，但在 subdivision 实践和 2026 LC 新政策处理上有差异。

papers.title: Measuring and Mitigating Bias in Code Generated by Large Language Models
papers.summary: GPT-4o 和 Gemini 这种主流代码生成模型在生成代码时也会带 bias。作者提了 CBS 和 ACR 两个指标量化 bias 程度，还试了 Few-Shot、CoT、Few-Shot CoT、Multi-agent 四种轻量缓解策略。结论是即使加了缓解，bias 在不同保护属性和数据集上仍然普遍存在，目前的策略远远不够。
papers.original_abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely recognised for their applications in natural language generation and are increasingly used for code generation tasks. However, concerns about bias in their generated outputs remain significant. This paper focuses on GPT-4o and Gemini, mainstream tools for code generation, and proposes a framework for evaluating bias in LLM-generated code, specifically examining the influence of protected attributes, prompts and web-search capability. We use two metrics: the code bias score (CBS) and the attribute change ratio (ACR), to quantify the prevalence of bias and the degree of influence of different attributes, respectively. In addition, we investigate four lightweight mitigation strategies: Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot Chain-of-Thought, and Multi-agent, aimed at mitigating bias in generated code. Our findings reveal that bias remains prevalent across different protected attributes and datasets even after applying mitigation strategies, highlighting the need for more effective approaches to reduce bias in AI-driven code generation systems.

highlights.contribution: 提出 LLM 代码生成 bias 的量化评测框架（CBS + ACR），并系统横评四种轻量缓解策略。
highlights.innovation: 把 bias 评测专门绑定到代码生成场景，区分 protected attribute、prompt 和 web-search 三个变量的影响。
highlights.method: 针对 GPT-4o 与 Gemini 评测；定义 code bias score 和 attribute change ratio；对比 Few-Shot、CoT、Few-Shot CoT、Multi-agent 四种缓解策略。
highlights.results: 四种策略都没能彻底消除 bias，bias 在 protected attributes 和不同数据集上仍持续存在。

papers.title: TRACE: A Metrologically-Grounded Engineering Framework for Trustworthy Agentic AI Systems in Operationally Critical Domains
papers.summary: 这篇是个跨域工程框架 TRACE：四层架构 + 经典 ML 和 LLM validator 显式分层（L2a/L2b）+ 状态化编排升级策略（L3）+ 有限人工监督（L4），再配一套对齐 GUM/VIM/ISO 17025 的 metrology 信任指标和『计算简约』原则（CPR）。在临床决策、工业多域运营、司法 AI 助手三个实例上展示。重点是把 LLM 用法变成有意识的设计选择而非默认。
papers.original_abstract: We introduce TRACE, a cross-domain engineering framework for trustworthy agentic AI in operationally critical domains. TRACE combines a four-layer reference architecture with an explicit classical-ML vs. LLM-validator split (L2a/L2b), a stateful orchestration-and-escalation policy (L3), and bounded human supervision (L4); a metrologically grounded trust-metric suite mapped to GUM/VIM/ISO 17025; and a Model-Parsimony principle quantified by the Computational Parsimony Ratio (CPR). Three instantiations--clinical decision support, industrial multi-domain operations, and a judicial AI assistant--transfer the samearchitecture and metrics across principally different governance contexts. The L2a/L2b separation makes the use of large language models a deliberate design decision rather than an architectural default, with parsimony quantified through CPR. TRACE introduces CPR as a first-class design principle in trustworthy-AI engineering.

highlights.contribution: 提出 metrology-grounded 工程框架 TRACE，把 trustworthy agentic AI 工程化、可量化、可跨域复用。
highlights.innovation: L2a/L2b 显式分离 classical ML 和 LLM validator；引入 Computational Parsimony Ratio 作为一等设计原则；信任指标对齐 GUM/VIM/ISO 17025。
highlights.method: 四层参考架构 + L2a/L2b 分层 + L3 状态编排升级 + L4 有限人工监督；trust metric 套件对齐计量学标准；CPR 量化模型简约；三个 instantiation（医疗/工业/司法）。
highlights.results: 三个 critical 领域上展示架构和指标可转移；属于框架性论文，未给量化基线对比。

papers.title: An Ethical eValuation Agent (EeVA): Results of a Proof-of-Concept Test on a Prototype Agentic-like Workflow to Assist Ethical Deliberations
papers.summary: 这篇论文做的是一个叫 EeVA 的 LLM 工作流，目标是帮助非伦理学背景的人做伦理推演，而不是直接给一个对错结论。作者用 n8n 串了三个子工作流（starter/worker/emitter），让系统按 10 个伦理框架去逐一评估上传的案例，再做综合。在城市交通、P2P 能源交易、社会服务资源分配三个公开案例上做了概念验证，输出能区分框架差异、找出共识和分歧，并给出可读性较好的综合报告。
papers.original_abstract: Ethical deliberation is often misunderstood as a search for single right or wrong answers, creating difficulties for non-ethically trained personnel who must address ethically laden challenges. We developed EeVA, an agentic-like LLM-based workflow designed to support comparative ethical reflection rather than deliver definitive ethical answers. EeVA was programmed in n8n using three interconnected workflows: starter, worker, and emitter. It evaluated uploaded use cases against 10 ethical frameworks through evaluator and synthesis prompts. Proof-of-concept testing used three published cases from urban mobility, peer-to-peer energy trading, and social-service resource allocation. Across all cases, EeVA produced consistently structured framework-specific evaluations and integrated syntheses. Outputs differentiated between frameworks, identified convergences and divergences, recommended modifications to increase alignment, and highlighted persistent ethical tensions. Syntheses were readable for non-specialists and shifted attention away from simplistic answers toward design conditions, safeguards, and areas where full cross-framework agreement was unlikely. The findings suggest that LLMs can be organised into usable workflows that preserve ethical plurality while helping bridge the communicative gap between ethicists and non-ethically trained personnel. EeVA's value lies not in replacing ethicists or resolving moral disagreement, but in scaffolding structured ethical deliberation. EeVA offers a promising proof of concept for supporting ethical reflection where access to ethics expertise is limited. Further work is needed on reproducibility, human evaluation, user testing, and efficiency before it can be considered a mature tool.

highlights.contribution: 提出 EeVA 这一 agentic LLM 工作流，把伦理审议从「找标准答案」转成「跨框架比较反思」，给缺乏伦理专家的场景提供脚手架。
highlights.innovation: 不追求单一伦理结论，而是用多框架并行评估 + 综合，保留伦理多元性，并把 ethicist 和普通人之间的沟通鸿沟拉近。
highlights.method: 用 n8n 搭三段式工作流：starter 接案例，worker 用 evaluator/synthesis 提示词对照 10 个伦理框架逐一评估，emitter 输出结构化报告；没有训练，纯 prompt 编排。
highlights.results: 在 3 个已发表案例上做概念验证，输出在所有案例上都呈现一致的框架级评估和综合，能识别框架间的趋同与分歧，并给出对非专业读者可读的综合摘要；尚未做人评和复现性测试。
